import asyncio, base64, edge_tts

async def main():

        "Hehe, hi Boo! I am Nanami, your new anime voice from the cloud!",
        "ja-JP-NanamiNeural", pitch="+10Hz", rate="+8%"
    ).save("/tmp/nanami.mp3")

        "Hey Boo! This is Ava with a higher pitch, testing the anime style!",
        "en-US-AvaNeural", pitch="+25Hz", rate="+5%"
    ).save("/tmp/ava.mp3")

asyncio.run(main())
